display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
并发 Start
(await start_done_，不重复 spawn)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
首个 Start 成功
(transport.Start + MarkRunning
+ spawn 读循环/handler)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
首个 Close
(汇合信号 + FailAll
+ 放行读循环收敛)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
致命错误自终
(读循环退出时仍 Running →
自发同一组汇合信号，ADR-0005 D5)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
后续 Close
(共享 closed_，多等待者)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
读循环收敛完成
(读循环退出→等 handler 退出
→close_drop→Closed)

span.p:
无重入守卫（ADR-0006 D8）：Close 结尾
无条件等 closed_。内部工作单元不走这里
—— 处理器经 RequestClose 只发信号不等待，
读循环收敛走内部路径。捕获 node* 硬调
Close 会挂死，属使用契约（RT_LIFECYCLE_005）

span.p:
Request/Send 仅在 Running 放行；
Created/Closing/Closed 一律 kClosed
